noun_definition: mweb refers to the mobile web version of the application where the issue of keyboard behavior upon clicking the confirm button in a chat context is being addressed.
Chat refers to the messaging interface within the application where users can send and receive messages, including password-protected PDFs.
Keyboard refers to the on-screen input interface that allows users to enter text, which should remain visible when the confirm button is clicked in the chat application.

Click refers to the action of pressing a button on the user interface, specifically the confirm button, during the process of entering a password for a password-protected PDF in the chat feature of the mWeb application.
Confirm button refers to the interactive element that the user clicks to submit a password in the chat interface when attempting to access a password-protected PDF.
